dimensions.note: Generate logs structured entry and completion events without input contents.
Strict parsing, ranking integrity, replay identity, and freshness checks all precede the sole resource write.

Tests cover deterministic bounds and ordering, strict malformed input rejection, stale and unavailable states, tampered ranking provenance and scores, no-authority output, and replay identity without partial writes.
Request identity is bound to queueId and deterministic generation writes a stable instance name; invalid replays fail before persistence.
No external handles or temporary resources.
README and fixtures use generic synthetic identifiers and example.com URLs.
Arguments, dossiers, ranking, provenance, and output objects are strict; imported ranking references and score totals are cross-validated.
The queue resource declares infinite lifetime and retains ten versions.
Pure queue evaluation is not an external CRUD lifecycle.
The method has no external mutation; validation is performed before its local resource write.
The only write targets queue with queue-<validated requestId>; requestId is bound to queueId.
